summary: Iteration 2 — Added 4 new pytest cases for the agent endpoints and exercised them end-to-end. 19/19 backend tests pass (15 regression + 4 new). Frontend smoke verified: 'Agente' sidebar entry navigates to /agent, page renders with token picker (2 active tokens), download button + Windows/Linux copy blocks, command string updates when switching token, and the Devices Connect modal correctly falls back to the mock screenshot for devices without an agent upload.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer width(-1)/height(-1) console warning persists from iteration 1. Not blocking, charts render once data arrives. Optional: add explicit minHeight to chart wrappers.

action_items: OPTIONAL (carry-over from iter 1): silence recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings via minHeight on Dashboard chart containers.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is now ~846 lines (>700). Strongly recommend splitting agent/devices/sessions/users into separate routers — server.py is becoming unmaintainable.

POST /api/agent/screenshot uses len(body.image_base64) > 4_000_000 as the 4MB guard but only AFTER FastAPI/Pydantic has already loaded the JSON body into memory. For a real ~4MB+ payload this still allocates the full string. Consider switching to a Request-level Content-Length check or a streaming endpoint to truly reject oversize before allocation.

Agent endpoints (/api/agent/register, /heartbeat, /screenshot) are completely unauthenticated besides the access-token / agent_secret pair. No per-token rate-limit and no IP allow-list. A leaked token allows unlimited device registrations. Consider: (a) max_uses on access_tokens, (b) per-IP rate-limit on /agent/register.

_auth_agent fetches the full device doc (incl. base64 screenshot) just to compare agent_secret. Use a projection {'_id':0,'agent_secret':1} to avoid loading the (potentially large) last_screenshot on every heartbeat.

Devices.jsx fires GET /api/devices/{id}/screenshot on every Connect click but does not handle the case where the endpoint returns 200 with image_base64: null — it works (falls back to mock) but consider also handling network/404 to avoid leaving the modal in a 'loading' state.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login, /agent nav + page, token picker switching, Connect modal mock fallback)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed access tokens (TEST_agent_tk, TEST_revoked_tk) and a TEST_AGT_host device via /agent/register; device is deleted at end of test. Two leftover TEST_*-prefixed access tokens remain visible in UI (TEST_agent_tk, plus older test-agent) but are harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Agent flow now fully tested at backend layer: register (valid token → 200 with device_id+rust_id+agent_secret+name; invalid → 401; revoked → 401), heartbeat (correct secret → 200 ok:true; wrong → 401), screenshot (tiny PNG → 200 + retrievable via GET /api/devices/{id}/screenshot; >4MB → 413), and GET /api/agent/script (200, text/x-python, starts with shebang). list_devices projection confirmed to exclude agent_secret and last_screenshot. Frontend Agent page works with token picker; cmd string updates on token switch. Connect modal: live-screenshot-mock shown when no agent screenshot (seeded devices); live-screenshot-real path tested in unit test via GET endpoint returning the uploaded b64 — UI render of real path NOT visually exercised because seeded devices have no screenshot AND the agent-registered device gets deleted in the test teardown. If you want to validate the real-image branch in the UI, run the agent script end-to-end OR seed one device with last_screenshot=<b64> directly in Mongo.
rca of the issue: n/a — no regressions, no new bugs.
